evidence: New no-network bounded replay verifies an explicitly pinned run ID and main SHA against an archived 0099 GitHub review JSON and exact saved WBM v2 ZIP. It rejects duplicate/nonfinite JSON, extra or missing receipt fields, changed ZIP and report SHA256, unsafe archive members, inconsistent measured v2/v1 candidate cost metrics, symlinks, oversize inputs and any false model training/generalization promotion. Produces a machine-readable local-only consistency result and preserves all original input bytes. New fixture tests added to canonical Fast CI.
limitations: No genuine WBM original source manually profiled in this PR; all new tests are synthetic
User-supplied archived review receipts cannot reauthenticate GitHub after artifact expiry, and this is not cryptographic signed provenance
Does not independently recompute full WBM or attest MACE-MPA-0 selected training records
No new MPTrj 1MiB/full-source transfer, Kaggle sAlex production run, or authorized unseen/calibration claim
